ST. BONAVENTURE'S MONASTERY 1740 MT. ELLIOTT AVENUE DETROIT, MICH.
February 18th, 1942 Rev. Michael Z. Cefai, D.D. 29 19-4th Street City
Dear Father Cefai :-
God bless you and yours-all our friends at St. Pauls To-morrow. Regret I have not been able to be with you as formerly. However, I shall remember you all in my prayers and holy Mass and be with you in spirit.
If ever it were in place to make our Blessed Mother Mary known, then it seems to me to be most opportune these days - so full of tur- moil and uncertainty. It would almost seem that anti Christ were already pushing his feindish plans.
We must pray, therefore, and by learning to know our Bl. Mother and to love her more merit a better knowledge of the Creator of all.
I hoped to reach you with a letter worth while but its been rush Rush all day long.
Thanks be to God, however, my health is improving and I hope that before long I shall be able to be with you again.
I received a very interesting letter from Rev. Mother Mary Gene- rose in Holy Family Convent, Manitowoc, Wisconsin ..... They ask our prayers. They quite enjoyed their visit with us last Nov. Ist.
God bless all at the holy Mass and subsequent meeting Tomorrow ... Sincerely in the Sacred Heart with our B1. Mother and Ven. Mary of Agreda.
Fr. Solanus, O.F.M.Cap.
